narrow: inhibition of host TLR pathway by virus
suppression by virus of host TLR signaling pathway
suppression by virus of host toll-like receptor signaling pathway

definition: A process in which a symbiont interferes with, inhibits or disrupts a toll-like receptor signaling pathway in the host organism. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction.
label: symbiont-mediated suppression of host toll-like receptor signaling pathway
